FORM: # Other glosses for kinship senses already mapped to KinDiv in kinship-kindiv.tsv.
# The ontology's own glosses ("males_sister") and WOLD's ("the mother's brother")
# often name exactly the concept White's Table 29 names, so the word ends up with
# the same sense two or three times. A row here gives such a gloss the KinDiv code
# of the Table 29 sense, and hmong2lmf.py then merges senses of one word that share
# a code, as it does senses that share an ILI.
# Only exact equivalents are listed. WOLD's broader meanings (muam 'sister', nus
# 'brother', pog 'grandmother', txiv hlob 'father's brother') are not: they are
# linked to a broader ILI or concept set and stay separate senses. niam tais
# 'mothers_sister; maternal_grandmother' is one ontology sense with two meanings, so
# it has no single code; Table 29 gives the two as separate senses.
